title: Emergence of $\mathrm{SU}(2)$: the full chain
html:
Example. Emergence of \mathrm{SU}(2): the full chain

Consider the representation category \mathbf{C} = \mathrm{Rep}(\mathrm{SU}(2)) with the standard forgetful functor \tau. The volume constraint requires \det(g_V) = 1. Specifically, the alternating form \epsilon(v \wedge w) = v_1 w_2 - v_2 w_1 on V = \mathbb{C}^2 is \mathrm{SU}(2)-invariant. Any tensor automorphism g must preserve \epsilon, forcing g_V \in \mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{C}). The dagger structure enforces unitarity, g_V^{-1} = g_V^{\dagger}, reducing the group from \mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{C}) to its compact real form \mathrm{SU}(2). We conclude that G = \mathrm{Aut}^{\otimes}(\tau) \cong \mathrm{SU}(2), recovering the gauge group from the categorical axioms.
